notes: Read SKILL.md (153 lines) in full; it is the only file. The skill scaffolds a VitePress site in a wiki-site/ directory from previously generated wiki Markdown, with dark-theme Mermaid config, CSS overrides, a click-to-zoom snippet, and Markdown post-processing rules.

The agent writes config/theme files under wiki-site/, rewrites generated .md pages (post-processing at lines 132-137), and runs `cd wiki-site && npm install && npm run docs:build` (line 142), which downloads npm packages from the public registry and runs the project's build script. Rated medium for the package install and build; it is scoped to the directory the skill itself creates and installs only the dependencies the generated package.json declares.

Line 17 mentions the `/deep-wiki:build` command from the parent deep-wiki plugin as one activation trigger; it is optional, the skill works standalone on any generated wiki Markdown. No package versions are pinned in the skill, so the install resolves whatever the generated package.json specifies.
